description: This file defines the ITimerRegistry interface for managing grain timers in Orleans, including methods for registering timers with specific options and an obsolete method for legacy support.

classes.name: ITimerRegistry
classes.description: Interface for managing grain timers, providing methods to register timers with specific configurations.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Creates a grain timer with specified due time and period; marked as obsolete.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Registers a grain timer with detailed options, including callback and timer settings.
